rows.note: Use this for someone who follows Impressionism, especially an artist working in that style.

example.english: This impressionist loves painting street scenes.
example.traditional: 呢位印象派藝術家最鍾意畫街景。
example.jyutping: ne1 wai6 jan3 zoeng6 paai3 ngai6 seot6 gaa1 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 waa2 gaai1 ging2

rows.note: Use this for a performer whose act is imitating other people.

example.english: That impressionist does a great impression of a certain singer.
example.traditional: 嗰個模仿藝人扮某位歌手扮得好似。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 mou4 fong2 ngai6 jan4 baan6 mau5 wai6 go1 sau2 baan6 dak1 hou2 ci5
